hookLine: Ranking the most cringeworthy magic trick fails from 5 to 1!

items.voiceLine: Number 5: Trying to pull a rabbit from the top hat and nearly dropping it instead.
Number 4: The coin trick where the coin just doesn't disappear.
Number 3: The duck cannon trick where the duck just casually strolled out instead.
Number 2: Pulling the tablecloth trick and sending everything crashing to the floor.
Number 1: The levitation trick where the assistant just lies there, not floating at all!
